description: Covers every dependency on trunk: npm/pnpm (all workspace packages, packageManager, lockfile), GitHub Actions, npm tools pinned in workflows, and the Maven and NuGet projects in tests/code-export. Only one Renovate branch and PR at a time.

customManagers.description: npm tools that workflows run with npx at a pinned version, like semver in release.yml.

packageRules.description: pnpm refuses npm versions published less than a day ago (minimumReleaseAge), so wait a little longer before proposing them.
Update electron and electron-chromedriver together, in their own PR. CI fails until both are on the same version.
Group GitHub Actions updates, majors included.
C# NUnit exports use Assert.True, which NUnit 4 removed.
Node.js types follow the oldest supported Node.js major (22).
